items.title: Mona Hinton interviewed by Milt Fillius and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: He just did the soundtrack for Spike’s new movie called “Clockers”

ctx.x: Spike. He just did the soundtrack for Spike’s new movie called “Clockers” I think is the name of it. So since 1930, he has worked with every musician. And I must tell you an interesting story about Quincy. For Milton’s 80th birthday I think it was, he sent a home made video, a homemade videotape to the house, and he had someone take it. And he’s standing there with his envelope and piece of paper, and he says, “Bring the camera up I want you to be sure and see this, that Milt can see that this is his handwriting…
I think there’s a tremendous message in that —
